# Gelium UI

> Server-rendered UI components for Tailwind CSS 4 and HTMX. HTML-first, 0-JS by default, token themes by class. Not a React/Vue runtime.

Gelium is an open-code component library: semantic HTML partials, CSS with `--ui-*` tokens, optional progressive-enhancement JS. The docs site is a Go `http.Handler` that dogfoods the same npm package consumers install.

## Install

```bash
npm install gelium-ui
```

- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/gelium-ui
- version: 0.5.3
- package root: CSS, themes, templates, js, dist

### CSS (drop-in)

```css
@import "gelium-ui/dist/gelium.css";
```

Prebuilt bundle: Tailwind preflight + theme-material + theme-basecoat + tokens + components (~169KB CSS).

### CSS (source + your Tailwind)

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "gelium-ui/themes/theme-material.css";
@import "gelium-ui/themes/theme-basecoat.css";
@import "gelium-ui/styles/index.css";
```

### Theme selection

Class on document root (no JS required):

```html
<html class="theme-material">
<html class="theme-material theme-dark" data-theme="dark">
<html class="theme-basecoat">
```

### Optional JS

```html
<script defer src="node_modules/gelium-ui/js/gelium.js"></script>
```

Provides: `gelium:toast` region, HTMX 422 swap when `X-Gelium-Validation: true`, range slider fill, same-document view transitions with reduced-motion guard.

### Templates

Copyable HTML under `node_modules/gelium-ui/templates/<name>.html` (e.g. `button.html`, `text-field.html`).

## When to use

- Server-rendered apps (Go, Rails, Laravel, Django, plain HTML)
- HTMX / progressive enhancement
- Design systems that must work with JS disabled
- Small JS budget (~5KB gelium.js + htmx if used)

## When NOT to use

- Need React/Vue/Svelte component APIs
- Need Shadow DOM / Web Components runtime
- Client-only SPA with no server HTML

## Wire contracts (server-driven)

- Header `X-Gelium-Validation: true` on HTTP 422 → HTMX may swap the fragment
- Event / HX-Trigger `gelium:toast` + region `#gelium-toast-region`
- Theme/scheme: server is authority; optimistic UI is progressive enhancement only

## Agent UX (MUST before generating screens)

Before inventing markup for a store, forum, or admin screen, fetch and follow **/llms-ux.txt** (SCREEN/JOURNEY/DATA/FEED/SKEL ids + DoD). Human narrative: /docs/screens, /docs/journeys, /docs/data-display, /docs/feedback, /docs/patterns, /docs/ui-definition-of-done (GOV.UK, USWDS, M3, NNG).

## Components (npm templates + CSS)

avatar, badge, banner, breadcrumb, button, callout, card, checkbox, chips, data-table, dialog, divider, elevation, empty-state, error-state, fab, feature-card, focus-ring, footer, hero, icon, icon-button, inline-alert, list, menu, navigation-bar, navigation-drawer, navigation-tab, newsletter, pagination, progress, radio, section-heading, segmented-button, select, skeleton, slider, split, switch, tabs, text-field, toast, tooltip, validation-summary, video

## Stack

- Go 1.24+ module `geliumui` (docs handler: `geliumui/internal/app`)
- Tailwind CSS 4, HTMX 4 (namespaced events, innerMorph)
- Monorepo: `lib/` = npm package, `site/` = docs consumer (dogfood by package name)
- Gates: `go test ./internal/... ./site/... ./lib/...` (never bare `./...`)
